title: Narrators
description: content/style/voice.json: one narrator per language, the same for every story in that language, written in that language (each language's REQUESTED_AUDIO.md quotes it to its narrator). The pace is shared: the app paces text without narration at the same speed. See docs/story-format.md.

pace.description: Words per minute per age band, in every language. The app's Pacing.wordsPerMinute() uses the same numbers.

narrators.description: Language code -> its narrator. Every language a story is written in needs one.

status.description: Proposed until the user approves it.

accent.description: Which variety of the language, and how it sounds.

clips.description: The direction for each kind of clip. An ending's title has none: the ending screen closes with the lines every story shares, directed in content/app/narration.json.

ending-page.description: An ending's page: the last words of the story, right before the shared "The End" clip.
